source_datasets.name: Population by religious denomination and Bundesland, 1951 to 2001
source_datasets.citation: Statistics Austria. Population censuses 1951 to 2001, population by religious denomination and Bundesland.

source_datasets.notes: Six full-enumeration census self-declaration waves: 1951, 1961, 1971, 1981, 1991, and 2001.

source_datasets.name: Religious affiliation of the Austrian population 2021 by Bundesland

source_datasets.notes: A voluntary sample survey of people aged 16+ in private households, with parent-based imputation for children under 16 and an estimate for the institutional population. Deepest geography: Bundesland.

indicators.label: Source population denominator
indicators.description: Total population in the Bundesland for the source wave.
indicators.method: Census total population for 1951-2001; weighted total-population estimate for 2021.
indicators.quality_notes: The 2021 values are weighted estimates and may be non-integer.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the source population denominator assigned to a reported religious-affiliation category.
indicators.quality_notes: 1951-2001 are census self-declarations. The 2021 value combines a voluntary sample survey, imputation for children, and an estimate for the institutional population.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the source population denominator reported or estimated as having no religious affiliation.
indicators.quality_notes: Not-stated census responses remain in the 1951-2001 denominator and outside both headline categories.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.description: Austria Bundesland religious-affiliation share for six census waves and the separate 2021 mixed estimate.
visual_layers.notes: The 2021 source-design break must remain explicit in map copy.

visual_layers.label: No religion %
visual_layers.description: Austria Bundesland no-religion share for six census waves and the separate 2021 mixed estimate.
visual_layers.notes: The census denominator includes not-stated responses.

rows.population_total_basis: Weighted 2021 total-population estimate: voluntary Microcensus Labour Force Survey module among people aged 16+ in private households, parent-based imputation for children under 16, and an estimate for the institutional population
rows.source_note: Religion is absent from the 2021 register census. The affiliation question was weighted to compensate for don't know and no information, leaving no unknown category. Official caveat: Values with less than extrapolated 6 000 persons are highly subject to random fluctuations.
